params.name: quoteCurrencyCode
params.description: The fiat currency to buy with.

params.name: quoteCurrencyAmount
params.description: The fiat amount the customer wants to spend. Must be a positive decimal with precision no higher than the currency precision.

params.name: paymentMethod
params.description: Payment method to be used for the order. If omitted, the quote will not factor in payment method fees.

params.name: usStateCode
params.description: US state code, e.g. `AL`. Ignored if `countryCode` is not `US`.

params.name: walletAddress
params.description: The wallet address where the user wants to receive the crypto.

items.docs:
Returns a real-time buy quote for a currency pair.
Supply `quoteCurrencyCode`, `baseCurrencyCode`, and `quoteCurrencyAmount` (fiat amount) to get a
detailed buy quote including fees and the amount of crypto the user will receive.
